issue_context.title: Error initialising hive component in 2021.3.2
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I tried to initialise the hive component in 2021.3.2 by adding

hive:
  username: <my username>
  password: <my password>

to configuration.yaml.

On restarting I got the following failure log from the hive component:

Logger: homeassistant.setup
Source: components/hive/__init__.py:113
First occurred: 9:43:55 PM (1 occurrences)
Last logged: 9:43:55 PM

Error during setup of component hive
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/setup.py", line 213, in _async_setup_component
    result = await task
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/hive/__init__.py", line 113, in async_setup
    config["username"] = config[DOMAIN][CONF_USERNAME]
KeyError: 'hive'

Checking the code in 2021.3.2 it seems to me there is no way the code at line 113 of __init__.py can work because config is initialised to an empty dictionary on the line before.  When I compare to 2021.2.2, reported working on the forums, the various items from config are assigned directly to local variables.

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.3.2

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

hive

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/hive/

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
# Put your YAML below this line
hive:
  username: YOUR_USERNAME
  password: YOUR_PASSWORD
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
# Put your logs below this line
Logger: homeassistant.setup
Source: components/hive/__init__.py:113
First occurred: 9:43:55 PM (1 occurrences)
Last logged: 9:43:55 PM

Error during setup of component hive
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/setup.py", line 213, in _async_setup_component
    result = await task
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/hive/__init__.py", line 113, in async_setup
    config["username"] = config[DOMAIN][CONF_USERNAME]
KeyError: 'hive'

```

The hive integration has be broken for a few releases now due to hive making change on their end. Apologies for this issue the final changes can be followed in this PR #47300
